title: test_auth_register_and_login_flow
description: Verify register and login flow. Step 1: POST /api/auth/register with body {"name": "Test User", "email": "unique@example.com", "password": "TestPass123!"} expects 201. Step 2: POST /api/auth/login with body {"email": same_email, "password": "TestPass123!"} expects 201 (NOT 200 because NestJS @Post defaults to 201). Response wrap: both return {data: {...}, meta: {...}}. Access token is at response.data.access_token.

title: test_auth_login_with_invalid_credentials
description: POST /api/auth/login with invalid body {"email": "wrong@test.com", "password": "wrongpass"} expects 401 unauthorized.

title: test_session_creation_and_listing_with_authentication
description: IMPORTANT: Login returns 201 NOT 200. Step 1: POST /api/auth/register with body {"name":"Test User","email":"unique@example.com","password":"TestPass123!"} expects 201. Step 2: POST /api/auth/login expects 201 (NOT 200). Get token from response.data.access_token (nested inside data wrapper). Step 3: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions (NOT /sessions/create) with body {"session_name":"test_session"} and Authorization Bearer token, expects 201. Get sessionId from response.data.id. Step 4: GET /api/whatsapp/sessions with auth, expects 200 with body {data: [{id, session_name, ...}], meta: {...}}.

title: test_session_creation_without_authentication
description: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions with body {"session_name": "test_session_without_auth"} and NO Authorization header expects 401 unauthorized.

title: test_whatsapp_send_message_with_authentication
description: IMPORTANT: Login returns 201 NOT 200. Step 1: POST /api/auth/register with body {"name":"Test User","email":"unique@example.com","password":"TestPass123!"} expects 201. Step 2: POST /api/auth/login expects 201 (NOT 200). Token at response.data.access_token. Step 3: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions (NOT /sessions/create) with body {"session_name":"test"}, get sessionId from response.data.id. Step 4: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions/{sessionId}/messages (NOT /api/whatsapp/send) with body {"type":"text","content":"Hello","conversation_id":"test"} and auth header, expects 201.

title: test_whatsapp_send_message_without_authentication
description: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions/test-id/messages with body {"type":"text","content":"Hello","conversation_id":"test"} and NO Authorization header expects 401 unauthorized.

title: test_whatsapp_webhook_receiver
description: POST /api/whatsapp/webhook with a valid webhook payload returns 201 Created with body {data: {status: "ok"}, meta: {...}}.

title: test_team_inbox_conversations_listing_with_authentication
description: IMPORTANT: Login returns 201 NOT 200. Step 1: POST /api/auth/register with body {"name":"Test User","email":"unique@example.com","password":"TestPass123!"} expects 201. Step 2: POST /api/auth/login expects 201 (NOT 200). Token at response.data.access_token. Step 3: POST /api/whatsapp/sessions with body {"session_name":"test"}, get sessionId from response.data.id. Step 4: GET /api/inbox/{sessionId}/conversations with auth header, expects 200 with body {data: {items: [...], total: N}, meta: {...}}.

title: test_team_inbox_conversations_listing_without_authentication
description: GET /api/inbox/test-session-id/conversations with NO auth header expects 200 with body {data: {items: [...], total: N}, meta: {...}} (this endpoint has no auth guard).

title: test_automation_rule_creation_with_valid_data
description: IMPORTANT: Register REQUIRES name field. Login returns 201 NOT 200. Step 1: POST /api/auth/register with body {"name":"Test User","email":"unique@example.com","password":"TestPass123!"} expects 201. DO NOT omit name field. Step 2: POST /api/auth/login expects 201 (NOT 200). Token at response.data.access_token (wrapped in data). Step 3: POST /api/automation-rules (NOT /api/chatbot/flows) with Authorization Bearer token and body {"name":"Test Flow","conditions":[{"field":"message.content","operator":"contains","value":"hi"}],"actions":[{"type":"reply.text","config":{"message":"Hello!"}}]} expects 201 with id at response.data.id.
